subject: Float over the smoot plot yields only the first point

messages.author: ca130dee0596482f
messages.subject: Float over the smoot plot yields only the first point
parts: When you float the cursor over a ggvis with tool tip and smoothed line, the tool tip reports the correct variables used in the smoothing but not the correct values at the coordinates.  It appears that it produces the left most value of the plot.

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Float over the smoot plot yields only the first point
parts:
Yes, this is because in vega, a line is an "atom" (so to speak). We're
not yet sure how to work around this limitation.
